facts.text: Established in 1923, FranU is a Catholic university whose education is grounded in Franciscan core values of service, reverence and love for all of life, joyfulness of spirit, humility and justice.

sources.title: Admission Requirements - FranU
sources.quote: Franciscan Missionaries of Our Lady University aspires to be the premier Catholic university in the Gulf Coast region. We live by our core values: service, reverence and love for all of life, joyfulness of spirit, humility and justice.
